body:
does this also work when no root indexName is given? i believe no result happens then, but to check. If it doesn't call the callback in that case, we need to listen to all derivedHelpers, not just the first one.

(it reminds me that i'm not 100% sure whether https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/bed6c5fd003da7ba85618cd5f2fb4ff1e60c50f9/packages/instantsearch.js/src/lib/server.ts#L17-L19 works correctly too)

we could need to check that clickAnalytics: true wasn't in the parameters

(and rules / secured api key, but that's not readable easily, maybe via `params`)
This is not needed anymore, as we have an explicit option coming from the engine now.

This flag is your internal parameter to decide to set `clickAnalytics=true`, which you don't want to do when you know the engine already did it, correct?

If yes, I think it deserves a rename because "automatic" refers to the behavior of auto-sending events, it's not exclusive to Dashboard opt-in IMO.
